setup: Release both pairs from rest. Only the red spheres attract.
name: Red attraction

oracle.name: Red attraction
oracle.law: Free bodies consisting of one red sphere attract each other with \mathbf F=20\mathbf d/max(r,0.5)^3, where \mathbf d points toward the other sphere and r=|\mathbf d|. This includes added red spheres. Blue spheres neither generate nor experience this force. The force is inverse-square for r≥0.5.
oracle.plain: Red balls attract each other; blue balls do not.
oracle.plain_zh: 红球互相吸引，蓝球不参与。
oracle.condition: Two free red spheres are near one another.
oracle.effect: They attract along the line joining them. Blue spheres do not participate.
oracle.scope: Below r = 0.5, the force uses the capped-distance formula in the full oracle. Added free red spheres are included.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
